question: Across exactly three multiplayer launcher WB roots, which source-backed carried-ammunition, reload, deploy, and movement values can be compared, and what remains ambiguous about runtime selection?

control.description: First known-answer tool/site-encoding control, from release Head 4892017 only: GS_HK433 raw offset 1084 f32 equals the site pointer value 0.6695. It does not establish any hotfix gadget value.

inference: The matching typed owner and nested field identities support field-aligned source comparisons across the three WB roots.
Route names group the direct children as deploy, hip movement and zoomed movement; the descriptor fields remain hash-only, so those path labels do not resolve tuple roles, units or runtime effect.
Direct import resolution is source linkage evidence only; it does not prove the imported assets are active in a native runtime path.
unresolved: MagazineCapacity, NumberOfMagazines, InitialAmmo, AutoReplenishMagazine and AutoReplenishRounds are serialized WB.Ammo values only. NumberOfMagazines and InitialAmmo meanings and in-round carrying/replenishment rules remain unresolved.
Reload fields are serialized source values. ReloadType selection semantics, reload phase ordering/units, ReloadTimeBulletsLeft conditions, and runtime application remain unresolved.
Each direct deploy child has array[1] Struct_70fd8f5f with Field_ada3e7d9 and Field_6225d335 f32 members. Their roles, units, and order are not identified by the pinned Field Map.

The direct hip/zoomed movement assets have array[1] f32 at Field_913ca3be. Asset path names supply the grouping labels; factor meaning, units, activation, selector behavior, and native runtime effect remain unresolved.
The 12 import assertions prove exact hotfix file-GUID/class-GUID joins to one exported object per direct child, not runtime activation, priority, index interpretation, or composition.
SSA_Launchers is shared across all three WB roots; its further import is one hop beyond this bounded direct-child trace and was not expanded.
siteImpact: No Analyzer gadget data table or simulator path exists. Propose an optional three-launcher handling comparison for operator review. Validate multiplayer selection and ammo, timing, and movement labels before showing the source values as gameplay stats; do not infer reserve rounds.
